 Summary:
   

  

 A Principal Engineer — Database \\& Middleware leads the hands\\-on design, build, and operation of enterprise data and integration platforms across relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL), NoSQL stores (MongoDB), cloud\\-native database services (AWS RDS/Aurora, GCP Cloud SQL, Azure Cosmos DB), and the full middleware stack — IBM MQ, Kafka, API Gateway, Tibco, MuleSoft, and service mesh.
   

  

 At, this individual operates as a recognized domain authority — engineering production\\-grade data and integration platforms, driving automation and observability, and owning reliability outcomes end to end. In a financial services context, every platform decision must satisfy PCI DSS, SOX, DORA, and data residency requirements while meeting the availability and latency demands of mission\\-critical business services.
   

  

 Roles \\& Responsibilities:
   

  

 Database Platform Engineering
   

  

 – Design, build, and operate enterprise relational database platforms — Oracle (RAC, Data Guard, ASM), SQL Server (AlwaysOn, SSAS, SSIS), and PostgreSQL — across on\\-premises and cloud environments
   

  

 – Engineer and maintain cloud\\-native database services — AWS RDS/Aurora, GCP Cloud SQL/Spanner, and Azure Cosmos DB — including provisioning, HA configuration, replication, and automated failover
   

  

 – Implement and operate MongoDB replica sets and sharded clusters for high\\-throughput, low\\-latency FSI workloads
   

  

 – Build and maintain database automation — IaC provisioning (Terraform), schema migration pipelines, backup/restore validation, and patching automation
   

  

 – Design and implement database high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity architectures — meeting RTO/RPO commitments for Tier 1 FSI workloads
   

  

 – Engineer database performance — query optimisation, index strategy, execution plan analysis, wait event diagnosis, and capacity right\\-sizing across all platforms
   

  

 – Implement and maintain database security controls — TDE, column\\-level encryption, RBAC, auditing, and data masking — aligned to PCI DSS and SOX requirements
   

  

 – Drive database observability — metrics collection, slow query alerting, replication lag monitoring, and capacity trending across on\\-premises and cloud estates
   

  

 Middleware \\& Integration Platform Engineering
   

  

 – Engineer and operate IBM MQ and RabbitMQ messaging infrastructure — queue manager configuration, channel security, HA clustering, and dead\\-letter queue management
   

  

 – Design and build Apache Kafka platforms — broker cluster operations, topic design, partition strategy, consumer group management, Schema Registry, and Kafka Connect pipelines
   

  

 – Engineer CA Siteminder Authentication platform and adapter configuration, process orchestration, HA deployment, and performance tuning
   

  

 – Design and operate enterprise API Gateway infrastructure — Kong, AWS API Gateway, or Apigee — including rate limiting, authentication, TLS termination, and API versioning
   

  

 – Implement and operate service mesh platforms — Istio or Linkerd — for microservices traffic management, mTLS enforcement, observability, and circuit breaking
   

  

 – Build CI/CD and GitOps pipelines for middleware platform configuration, integration flow deployment, and schema lifecycle management
   

  

 – Drive integration platform observability — distributed tracing, message throughput dashboards, error rate alerting, and end\\-to\\-end latency analysis across the integration stack
   

  

 Technical Leadership \\& Engineering Excellence
   

  

 – Set platform engineering standards, reference patterns, and IaC module libraries for database and middleware platforms — codified and reusable across teams
   

  

 – Conduct production readiness reviews and technical design assessments for data and integration workstreams
   

  

 – Lead proof\\-of\\-concept engineering for emerging database and integration technologies — delivering evidence\\-based build\\-vs\\-buy recommendations
   

  

 – Mentor senior and mid\\-level engineers in database internals, integration patterns, and production operations
   

  

 – Drive continuous improvement — reducing toil through automation, improving platform reliability, and eliminating technical debt across the data and middleware estate
   

  

 – Support audit, regulatory, and risk management activities — producing platform configuration evidence, data lineage documentation, and compliance reports
   

  

 Professional \\& Technical Skills:
   

  

 Must\\-Have Technical Skills
   

  

 Oracle Engineering: RAC, Data Guard, ASM, RMAN — performance tuning, AWR/ASH analysis, schema design, and HA/DR implementation at enterprise scale
   

  

 SQL Server Engineering: AlwaysOn AG, SSAS, SSIS, SSRS — query tuning, execution plans, index optimisation, and HA configuration for FSI workloads
   

  

 PostgreSQL: Streaming replication, logical replication, partitioning, VACUUM tuning, pg stat analysis, and extensions (TimescaleDB, PostGIS, Citus)
   

  

 MongoDB: Replica set and sharded cluster operations, aggregation pipeline optimisation, index strategy, Atlas operations, and change stream engineering
   

  

 Cloud DB Services: AWS RDS/Aurora (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle), GCP Cloud SQL/Spanner, Azure Cosmos DB — provisioning, HA, replication, and cost optimisation
   

  

 Kafka: Broker operations, topic/partition design, consumer group management, Kafka Connect, Schema Registry, MirrorMaker 2, and exactly\\-once semantics
   

  

 MuleSoft: Anypoint Platform — API design (RAML/OAS), DataWeave transformation, Mule runtime management, CloudHub deployment, and API\\-led connectivity
   

  

 IBM MQ / Tibco: MQ queue manager HA clustering, channel security, dead\\-letter handling Tibco BW/EMS process design, adapter configuration, and performance tuning
   

  

 API Gateway \\& Service Mesh: Kong/Apigee policy design, rate limiting, OAuth2/mTLS enforcement Istio traffic management, circuit breaking, and observability
   

  

 IaC \\& Automation: Terraform for database and middleware provisioning, Ansible for configuration management, and CI/CD pipelines for schema and integration deployment
   

  

 Observability: Database and middleware monitoring — Prometheus/Grafana, Datadog, ELK — slow query analysis, message lag alerting, and distributed tracing
   

  

 FSI Compliance: PCI DSS, SOX, DORA — database encryption (TDE, column\\-level), audit logging, data residency, masking, and regulatory evidence production
   

  

**Preferred / Advantageous**

 – Familiarity with GraphQL or AsyncAPI for API and event schema governance in integration platforms
